types.name: orders.v1.CancelAllOrdersResponse.ListingStatus
types.doc: Availability of the order listing, separate from the submission outcome.

values.name: INCLUDED
values.doc: The initial response includes its listing, possibly empty, up to 200 orders.

values.name: NOT_RETAINED_READ_OPEN_ORDERS
values.doc:
A retry returns its original outcome and counts without the historical
 listing. Read open orders for current state and use order updates for
 final outcomes. No new cancellations are requested by the retry.

values.name: SUBMITTED
values.doc: Matching cancellation requests were submitted for processing.

values.name: DRY_RUN
values.doc: The request only counted matching orders and submitted no cancellations.
